overall.assessment: Podcast snažno usmjerava slušatelja prema Kristu, molitvi, pouzdanju u Božje milosrđe, obraćenju i misionarskom navještaju, a žalosna otajstva i prispodoba o velikoj večeri mogu poduprijeti vjeru koja se pretače u svakodnevni život. Ipak, prema samom opisu tema, oštro suprotstavljanje kršćanstva drugim religijama i naglašavanje posebnih objava mogu zamagliti razliku između jedinstvenosti spasenja u Kristu i pitanja kako Božja milost djeluje u onima koji Evanđelje nisu upoznali; poziv na obraćenje treba ostati povezan s poštovanjem, ljubavlju i kršćanskim svjedočenjem. Molitva zaštite može biti izraz pouzdanja u Boga, ali formulacije o „vezivanju“ zlih sila valja tumačiti kao prošnju za Božju zaštitu, a ne kao automatiziranu tehniku ili zamjenu za sakramentalni i crkveni život. Poziv na članstvo i donacije nije sam po sebi problematičan, no njegova vjerodostojnost ovisi o transparentnosti, odgovornom upravljanju i stvarnom služenju ljudima, osobito siromašnima.
seeds_of_logos: Krunica Božjega milosrđa, žalosna otajstva, zaziv „Isuse, uzdam se u tebe“ i molitva u teškim trenucima usmjeravaju prema Kristovoj muci, nadi i pouzdanju u Boga, umjesto očaju.
Naglasak da je Isus Krist Gospodin i put spasenja čuva središnje mjesto Krista u kršćanskoj vjeri; navještaj je uvjerljiviji kada je praćen svjedočenjem života i djelima ljubavi.

Prispodoba o velikoj večeri i poziv siromasima i onima izvan uobičajenih krugova vjernika mogu izraziti širinu Božjeg poziva i misionarsku otvorenost, bez svođenja dostojanstva osobe na njezinu vjersku pripadnost.

Podsjetnik da posao, karijera i obiteljske obveze ne smiju postati apsolutne može potaknuti razlučivanje prioriteta i slobodan odgovor na Božji poziv, uz poštovanje legitimnih obiteljskih i radnih dužnosti.
Poziv na donacije može biti konkretan oblik zajedništva i potpore evangelizaciji, ako sredstva služe stvarnim potrebama i upravljaju se odgovorno i transparentno.
concerns: Izraz „nema drugih puteva spasenja“ može ispravno isticati da je spasenje u konačnici od Krista, ali bez dodatnog objašnjenja može zvučati kao da su unaprijed osuđeni svi koji Krista nisu upoznali ili nisu vidljivo članovi Crkve. Katoličko naviještanje jedinstvenosti Krista treba držati zajedno s pozivom da se osobe izvan vidljivog zajedništva susreću bez neprijateljstva i služe im djelima kršćanske ljubavi.

Upozorenja na New Age i spajanje religija mogu pomoći u razlučivanju, ali općenite osude bez preciznog razlikovanja vjerovanja, ljudi i pojedinih tvrdnji riskiraju zamijeniti dijalog i istinoljubivost polarizacijom.

Garabandal, Akita, Međugorje i „plava knjiga“ ne bi smjeli biti prikazani kao nadomjestak za Sveto pismo, apostolsku vjeru ili javnu Objavu, niti kao temelj za tvrdnje o „novom biblijskom dobu“ bez jasnog crkvenog razlučivanja. Iz dostavljenog opisa nije moguće utvrditi kako su te pojave konkretno ocijenjene.

Molitvene formule o „vezivanju“ zlih sila mogu, ako se shvate mehanički ili kao vlastita moć nad duhovnim svijetom, skrenuti u magijski način razmišljanja; sigurnije ih je razumjeti kao poniznu molbu Bogu za zaštitu i oslobođenje.

Tvrdnja da su kršteni „pod strožim sudom“ može podsjetiti na odgovornost koju donosi primljena vjera, ali ako se naglašava bez Božjega milosrđa i mogućnosti obraćenja, može potaknuti strah ili duhovni pritisak umjesto zrele savjesti.

Najave inicijative, učlanjivanje i prikupljanje donacija zahtijevaju transparentnost o svrsi, upravljanju i uporabi sredstava; socijalni nauk upozorava da dobra služe općem dobru te da razvoj i pomoć moraju poštovati dostojanstvo i odgovornost ljudi kojima su namijenjeni.
overall.theological_context: Katehetski okvir obuhvaća Kristovu jedinstvenu ulogu, misijsko poslanje Crkve, naviještanje svjedočenjem života, Kristove prispodobe, obraćenje i nošenje križa; te teme izrijekom povezuje s odgovarajućim odlomcima Katekizma Direktorij za homilije. O spasenju izvan vidljivog zajedništva valja govoriti bez vjerskog indiferentizma, ali i bez neprijateljstva prema onima koji nisu katolici: dostavljeni tekst istodobno ističe crkveno učenje i dužnost kršćanske ljubavi prema njima. Socijalni nauk traži da se materijalna dobra usmjeravaju prema općem dobru, da se siromašnima pristupa kao osobama s dostojanstvom i odgovornošću te da crkvene dobrotvorne inicijative budu vođene primjereno i transparentno.

overall.assessment_en: The podcast strongly directs the listener toward Christ, prayer, trust in Divine Mercy, conversion, and missionary proclamation, and the sorrowful mysteries and the parable of the great banquet can support a faith that translates into everyday life. Nevertheless, according to the very description of the themes, the sharp opposition of Christianity to other religions and the emphasis on special revelations can obscure the distinction between the uniqueness of salvation in Christ and the question of how God's grace acts in those who have not come to know the Gospel; the call to conversion should remain connected with respect, love, and Christian witness. The prayer of protection can be an expression of trust in God, but formulations about "binding" evil forces should be interpreted as a petition for God's protection, rather than as an automated technique or a substitute for sacramental and ecclesial life. The call for membership and donations is not problematic in itself, but its credibility depends on transparency, accountable management, and genuine service to people, especially the poor.
overall.theological_context_en: The catechetical framework encompasses Christ's unique role, the missionary mandate of the Church, proclamation through the witness of life, Christ's parables, conversion, and carrying the cross; the Homiletic Directory explicitly links these themes with the corresponding paragraphs of the Catechism. Salvation outside visible communion should be spoken of without religious indifferentism, but also without hostility toward those who are not Catholic: the provided text simultaneously emphasizes Church teaching and the duty of Christian charity toward them. Social doctrine requires that material goods be directed toward the common good, that the poor be approached as persons with dignity and responsibility, and that ecclesial charitable initiatives be conducted appropriately and transparently.
seeds_of_logos_en: The Chaplet of Divine Mercy, the sorrowful mysteries, the aspiration "Jesus, I trust in You," and prayer in difficult moments direct toward Christ's passion, hope, and trust in God, instead of despair.

The emphasis that Jesus Christ is Lord and the way of salvation preserves the central place of Christ in Christian faith; the proclamation is more convincing when accompanied by the witness of life and deeds of love.

The parable of the great banquet and the call to the poor and those outside the usual circles of believers can express the breadth of God's call and missionary openness, without reducing the dignity of the person to their religious affiliation.

The reminder that work, career, and family obligations must not become absolute can encourage the discernment of priorities and a free response to God's call, while respecting legitimate family and work duties.
The call for donations can be a concrete form of communion and support for evangelization, provided the funds serve real needs and are managed responsibly and transparently.
concerns_en: The phrase "there are no other ways of salvation" can correctly emphasize that salvation ultimately comes from Christ, but without further explanation it can sound as though everyone who has not known Christ or is not visibly a member of the Church is condemned in advance. Catholic proclamation of the uniqueness of Christ should be held together with the call to encounter persons outside visible communion without hostility and to serve them through deeds of Christian love.

Warnings about the New Age and the merging of religions can help in discernment, but generalized condemnations without a precise distinction between beliefs, people, and individual claims risk replacing dialogue and truthfulness with polarization.

Garabandal, Akita, Međugorje, and the "blue book" should not be presented as a substitute for Sacred Scripture, the apostolic faith, or public Revelation, nor as a foundation for claims about a "new biblical era" without clear ecclesial discernment. From the provided description, it is not possible to determine how those phenomena are concretely evaluated.

Prayer formulas about "binding" evil forces can, if understood mechanically or as one's own power over the spiritual world, veer into a magical way of thinking; it is safer to understand them as a humble petition to God for protection and deliverance.

The claim that the baptized are "under stricter judgment" can recall the responsibility brought by received faith, but if emphasized without God's mercy and the possibility of conversion, it can foster fear or spiritual pressure instead of a mature conscience.

Announcements of the initiative, enrollment, and collection of donations require transparency regarding the purpose, governance, and use of funds; social doctrine warns that goods serve the common good and that development and assistance must respect the dignity and responsibility of the people for whom they are intended.

sections.subtitle: Poziv na gozbu: evanđelje dana kao uvod u molitvu
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar pozdravlja gledatelje i slušatelje medija Ora et Labora i čita evanđelje dana
sections.content:
Emisija počinje kratko i jasno. Voditelj **Vladimir Grebenar** pozdravlja „dragе gledatelje i slušatelje medija Ora et Labora“ i odmah izgovara misao koja daje ton cijeloj epizodi. Evanđelje dana glasi:

> „Iziđi na putove i među ograde, i prisili neka uđu, da mi se napuni kuća.“

Riječ je o retku iz prispodobe o velikoj večeri. Voditelj ga na samom početku samo najavljuje, a detaljnije će se njime baviti tek nakon molitvenog dijela. Ova slika domaćina koji želi da mu se kuća napuni gostima pritom se prirodno nadovezuje na sadržaj koji slijedi: dugi i bogati molitveni blok u kojemu se vjernike poziva u zajedništvo s Bogom, Marijom i svetima.

Prvih tridesetak minuta emisije posvećeno je molitvi. Taj dio obuhvaća molitve zaštite i posvete, krunicu i litanije Božjem milosrđu te Gospinu krunicu sa žalosnim otajstvima. Struktura je ustaljena i ritmična, a molitve se nižu jedna za drugom bez dodatnih komentara.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak prenosi biblijski redak iz prispodobe o velikoj večeri i prikazuje molitvu kao poziv u zajedništvo s Bogom, što je u skladu s katoličkom vjerom. Važno je da se „prisili neka uđu” razumije kao snažan poziv i ustrajno nuđenje Božjeg poziva, a ne kao prisila na vjeru, koja mora ostati slobodan čin.
magisterium.enrichment: U Lk 14,23 gospodar šalje slugu na putove i ograde kako bi se kuća napunila; taj redak izražava širinu poziva, uključujući one koji su izvan uobičajenih krugova uzvanika. Katekizam naglašava da je odgovor vjere po svojoj naravi slobodan i da Krist ljude privlači ljubavlju, a ne prisilom.

It is important that "compel people to come in" is understood as a strong invitation and persistent offering of God's call, and not as coercion into faith, which must remain a free act.

sections.subtitle_en: Call to the banquet: Gospel of the day as an introduction to prayer
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar greets the viewers and listeners of the Ora et Labora media and reads the Gospel of the day
sections.content_en:
The show begins shortly and clearly. Host **Vladimir Grebenar** greets "dear viewers and listeners of the Ora et Labora media" and immediately utters a thought that sets the tone for the entire episode. The Gospel of the day reads:

> "Go out into the roads and hedgerows, and compel them to enter, that my house may be filled."

This is a verse from the parable of the great banquet. At the very beginning, the host only announces it, and will deal with it in more detail only after the prayer part. This image of the host who wants his house to be filled with guests naturally connects to the content that follows: a long and rich prayer block in which the faithful are invited into communion with God, Mary, and the saints.

The first thirty minutes or so of the show are dedicated to prayer. That part includes prayers of protection and consecration, the Chaplet and Litany of the Divine Mercy, and the Rosary of Our Lady with the sorrowful mysteries. The structure is established and rhythmic, and the prayers follow one another without additional commentary.

sections.subtitle: „U ime Isusovo vežem sve zle sile“: molitva oslobođenja i zaštite
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli molitvu oslobođenja i zaštite, vezujući zle sile u ime Isusovo
sections.content:
Nakon znaka križa Vladimir Grebenar započinje **molitvu oslobođenja i zaštite**. Ona ima izrazito borben, gotovo zapovjedni karakter. Molitelj u ime Isusovo „uzima vlast“ i vezuje sve zle sile i snage, a molitva ih nabraja redom:

- u zraku,
- na zemlji,
- u vodi,
- u podzemlju,
- na onome svijetu,
- u prirodi
- i u vatri.

Molitva zatim ispovijeda Isusa kao Gospodina nad svim svemirom kojemu se daje slava „u ime tvoga stvorenja“. Sve demonske sile koje su „došle protiv nas i naših obitelji“ vezuju se u njegovo ime. Molitelji se stavljaju pod zaštitu Kristove **dragocjene krvi**, prolivene na križu.

U drugom dijelu molitva se obraća Mariji, „našoj majci“. Od nje se traži zagovor kod Presvetog Srca Isusova za sve obitelji te da ih zaogrne „svojim plaštem ljubavi, da se prestraši neprijatelj“. U pomoć se zazivaju i sveti Mihovil te anđeli čuvari, da brane obitelji „u borbi protiv svega zla što obilazi svijetom“.

Molitva završava zapovijedi svim silama zla da „odstupe istog časa“ od molitelja, njihovih domova i zemlje. Na kraju dolazi zahvala Isusu „jer si vjeran Bog i osjećaš s nama“.

### Sveti Mihaele, arkanđele

Slijedi poznata **molitva svetom Mihaelu arkanđelu**. U njoj se arkanđela moli da brani vjernike „u boju protiv pakosti i zasjeda đavolskih“ i da im bude zaklon. Kao „vojvodu vojske nebeske“ moli ga se da Sotonu i druge zlobne duhove, „koji svijetom obilaze na propast duša“, božanskom krjepošću i jakošću „u pakao strovali“.

magisterium.assessment: Molitva zaštite i zazivi Mariji, svetom Mihaelu i anđelima čuvarima u osnovi su usklađeni s katoličkom pobožnošću i vjerom u Božju pobjedu nad zlom; osobito je molitva svetom Mihaelu bliska tekstu koji se nalazi u katolickom obredu egzorcizama. Nejasnoća je u tome, da se molitelj opisuje kao onaj koji „uzima vlast” i izravno veže sve zle sile na širokom popisu područja, što može zamagliti razliku između prošnje za Božju zaštitu i obrednog egzorcizma.
concerns: Izraz „uzimam vlast” i zapovijed svim silama zla mogu ostaviti dojam da molitelj samostalno raspolaže vlašću nad zlim duhovima; katolički obred moli svetog Mihaela da djeluje božanskom krepošću, pa je korisno jasno istaknuti da je pobjeda Božja, a ne čovjekova vlastita moć.

Nabrajanje sila „u zraku”, „u vodi”, „u podzemlju”, „na onome svijetu”, „u prirodi” i „u vatri” nije samo po sebi dovoljno da se utvrdi proturječje nauku, ali može zvučati kao tvrdnja o demonskoj prisutnosti u svim tim područjima; odlomak ne daje objašnjenje koje bi tu formulaciju razjasnilo.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolička molitva protiv zla oslanja se na Kristovo otkupljenje i Božju zaštitu, a ne na tehniku ili formulu kojom bi molitelj automatski upravljao duhovnim silama. Službeni tekst molitve svetom Mihaelu traži da arkanđeo brani vjernike i da zle duhove Božjom snagom strovali u pakao; Crkva također poznaje zazive Marijinu zagovoru i zaštiti anđela čuvara.

magisterium.assessment_en: The prayer of protection and invocations to Mary, Saint Michael, and the guardian angels are basically in alignment with Catholic piety and faith in God's victory over evil; in particular, the prayer to Saint Michael is close to the text found in the Catholic rite of exorcisms. The ambiguity lies in the fact that the person praying is described as one who "takes authority" and directly binds all evil forces across a broad list of areas, which can obscure the distinction between a petition for God's protection and ritual exorcism.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic prayer against evil relies on Christ's redemption and God's protection, not on a technique or formula by which the person praying would automatically command spiritual forces. The official text of the prayer to Saint Michael asks that the archangel defend believers and cast evil spirits into hell by the power of God; the Church also recognizes invocations of Mary's intercession and the protection of guardian angels.
concerns_en: The phrase "I take authority" and the command to all forces of evil can give the impression that the person praying independently possesses authority over evil spirits; the Catholic rite prays to Saint Michael to act by divine power, so it is useful to point out clearly that the victory belongs to God, and is not man's own power.

Listing forces "in the air", "in the water", "in the underworld", "in the other world", "in nature", and "in fire" is not in itself sufficient to establish a contradiction with doctrine, but it can sound like an assertion of a demonic presence in all those areas; the passage does not provide an explanation that would clarify that formulation.

sections.subtitle_en: "In the name of Jesus I bind all evil forces": prayer of deliverance and protection
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host prays the prayer of deliverance and protection, binding evil forces in the name of Jesus
sections.content_en:
After the sign of the cross, Vladimir Grebenar begins the **prayer of deliverance and protection**. It has a distinctly combative, almost commanding character. In the name of Jesus, the person praying "takes authority" and binds all evil powers and forces, and the prayer lists them in order:

- in the air,
- on the earth,
- in the water,
- in the underworld,
- in the other world,
- in nature
- and in the fire.

The prayer then confesses Jesus as Lord over the entire universe to whom glory is given "in the name of your creation." All demonic forces that have "come against us and our families" are bound in his name. The persons praying place themselves under the protection of Christ's **precious blood**, shed on the cross.

In the second part, the prayer addresses Mary, "our mother." Her intercession with the Sacred Heart of Jesus is requested for all families, and that she clothe them "with her mantle of love, so that the enemy is frightened." Saint Michael and guardian angels are also called upon for help, to defend families "in the battle against all evil that roams the world."

The prayer ends with a command to all forces of evil to "depart immediately" from the persons praying, their homes, and land. At the end comes thanksgiving to Jesus "because you are a faithful God and you feel with us."

### Saint Michael the Archangel

The well-known **prayer to Saint Michael the Archangel** follows. In it, the archangel is asked to defend the faithful "in battle against the wickedness and snares of the devil" and to be their protection. As "prince of the heavenly host" he is asked to, by the divine power and strength, "cast into hell" Satan and other evil spirits "who roam through the world for the ruin of souls."

sections.subtitle: Srca koja kucaju zajedno: molitve jedinstva i posvete
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar moli posvetu Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu
sections.content:
Nakon molitava zaštite ton se omekšava. Vladimir Grebenar moli kratku, gotovo poetsku molitvu **„Moj ljupki Isuse“**. U njoj se jedinstvo s Kristom izražava nizom slika tjelesne i duhovne bliskosti:

- neka naše noge zajedno hode,
- neka naše ruke budu skupljene u jedinstvu,
- neka naša srca kucaju zajedno,
- neka naše duše budu u skladu,
- neka naše misli budu kao jedno,
- neka naše uši zajedno „slušaju tišinu“,
- neka naši pogledi duboko prodru jedan u drugi,
- neka naše usne zajedno mole da zadobijemo milosrđe od vječnoga Oca.

### Posveta Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu

Slijedi **posveta Bezgrešnom Srcu Marijinu**, molitva osobnog predanja u prvom licu jednine. Molitelj Presvetoj Djevici Mariji, „majci i kraljici“, posvećuje „čitavo svoje biće, svoje misli, riječi i djela“. Moli je da raspolaže njime i svime što mu pripada, „na hvalu i slavu Presvetoga Trojstva, za posvećenje Crkve i spasenje svega svijeta“. Posveta se dotiče i krsnog posvećenja: Marija se moli da pomogne živjeti dostojno krštenja, kako bi molitelj „neopozivo pripadao svome Otkupitelju“. Završava željom da molitelj, poput nje, sluša poticaje Duha Svetoga.

### Molitva Presvetom Srcu Isusovu

Uvodni niz zatvara **molitva Presvetom Srcu Isusovu**, „izvoru svakoga dobra“. Molitelj se klanja, vjeruje, ufa i kaje za grijehe te Isusu poklanja svoje „siromašno srce“ s molbom da ga učini poniznim, strpljivim i čistim. Molitva je i vrlo konkretna. Traži se zaštita u opasnostima, utjeha u nevoljama, zdravlje tijela i blagoslov rada. Na kraju se moli za „milost svete smrti“.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je u skladu s katoličkom pobožnošću: Marijina se posveta izričito usmjerava na slavu Trojstva, posvećenje Crkve i vjernost Kristu, a molitva Presvetom Srcu Isusovu traži kreposti i milost. Slike zajedničkog hoda, mišljenja i molitve najbolje je razumjeti kao poetski izraz bliskosti i suobličenja Kristu, a ne kao stapanje osobe s Bogom.
magisterium.enrichment: Katoličko štovanje Srca Isusova usredotočeno je na Kristovu osobu i ljubav očitovanu u njegovu probodenom boku; vjernici su pozvani živjeti u zajedništvu s njim i slijediti njegovu poniznost. Posveta Marijinu Srcu u ovom opisu ne zamjenjuje Krista ni Trojstvo, nego Mariju prikazuje kao pomoć u životu po krsnom pozivu i u usmjeravanju prema Isusovu Srcu.

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is in accordance with Catholic piety: the consecration to Mary is explicitly directed toward the glory of the Trinity, the sanctification of the Church, and fidelity to Christ, and the prayer to the Most Sacred Heart of Jesus asks for virtues and grace. The images of walking, thinking, and praying together are best understood as a poetic expression of closeness and conformity to Christ, rather than as an absorption of the person into God.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic devotion to the Heart of Jesus is centered on the person of Christ and the love manifested in His pierced side; the faithful are called to live in communion with Him and follow His humility. In this description, consecration to the Heart of Mary does not replace Christ or the Trinity, but presents Mary as a help in living according to the baptismal vocation and in directing toward the Heart of Jesus.

sections.subtitle_en: Hearts beating together: prayers of unity and consecration
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar prays the consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary
sections.content_en:
After the prayers of protection, the tone softens. Vladimir Grebenar prays a short, almost poetic prayer **"My lovely Jesus"**. In it, unity with Christ is expressed through a series of images of physical and spiritual closeness:

- may our feet journey together,
- may our hands be gathered in unity,
- may our hearts beat together,
- may our souls be in harmony,
- may our thoughts be as one,
- may our ears together "listen to the silence",
- may our glances penetrate deeply into each other,
- may our lips pray together to obtain mercy from the eternal Father.

### Consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary

The **consecration to the Immaculate Heart of Mary** follows, a prayer of personal surrender in the first person singular. The person praying consecrates to the Blessed Virgin Mary, "mother and queen," "one's entire being, one's thoughts, words, and deeds." One asks her to dispose of oneself and everything that belongs to oneself, "for the praise and glory of the Most Holy Trinity, for the sanctification of the Church and the salvation of the whole world." The consecration also touches upon baptismal consecration: Mary is asked to help live worthily of baptism, so that the person praying would "irrevocably belong to one's Redeemer." It ends with a wish that the person praying, like her, listen to the promptings of the Holy Spirit.

### Prayer to the Sacred Heart of Jesus

The introductory series closes with the **prayer to the Sacred Heart of Jesus**, the "source of every good." The person praying adores, believes, hopes, and repents of sins, offering to Jesus one's "poor heart" with the plea to make it humble, patient, and pure. The prayer is also very concrete. Protection in dangers, consolation in troubles, bodily health, and blessing of work are sought. At the end, prayer is made for the "grace of a holy death."

sections.subtitle: „Po njegovoj pregorkoj muci“: krunica Božjega milosrđa
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj izgovara molitvu „Vječni Oče, prikazujemo ti tijelo i krv…“ na početku desetice krunice milosrđa
sections.content:
„Slijedi krunica Božjega milosrđa“, najavljuje Vladimir Grebenar. Taj dio čini središte molitvenog bloka i povezuje se s naslovom epizode, koji je posvećen upravo Božjem milosrđu.

Krunica počinje uobičajenim uvodnim molitvama: **Oče naš**, **Zdravo Marijo** i **Vjerovanje**. U Vjerovanju se ispovijeda vjera u Boga Oca Stvoritelja, u Isusa Krista koji je „mučen pod Poncijem Pilatom, raspet, umro i pokopan“ te treći dan uskrsnuo, u Duha Svetoga, svetu Crkvu katoličku, općinstvo svetih, oproštenje grijeha, uskrsnuće tijela i život vječni.

Zatim slijedi srce ove pobožnosti. Svaka desetica otvara se prikazanjem:

> „Vječni Oče, prikazujemo ti tijelo i krv, dušu i božanstvo preljubljenoga sina tvojega, Gospodina našega Isusa Krista, kao zadovoljštinu za grijehe naše i cijeloga svijeta.“

Nakon toga, poput molitvenog daha, više puta zaredom slijedi zaziv:

> „Po njegovoj pregorkoj muci, budi milosrdan nama i cijelome svijetu.“

Ovaj se obrazac ponavlja kroz sve desetice, od otprilike četvrte do dvanaeste minute emisije. Jednolično, meditativno ponavljanje stavlja Kristovu muku u središte molitve kao razlog za koji se od Oca traži milosrđe. Pritom se ne moli samo za sebe, nego za „cijeli svijet“.

magisterium.assessment: Opis krunice Božjega milosrđa u bitnome je usklađen s katoličkom vjerom: usmjerava molitvu Ocu po Kristovoj muci i traži milosrđe za sve ljude. Izraz „kao zadovoljštinu“ valja razumjeti u ovisnosti o jedinstvenoj Kristovoj žrtvi, a ne kao ponavljanje ili nadopunjavanje otkupljenja vlastitom snagom.
magisterium.enrichment: U prikazanoj pobožnosti vjernici prinose Ocu Kristovo tijelo i krv, dušu i božanstvo te se sjedinjuju s njegovom žrtvom dok mole za sebe i cijeli svijet. Krist je svoj život prinio na križu kao žrtvu za grijehe; zato se zaziv za milosrđe oslanja na njegovo dovršeno otkupiteljsko djelo, a ne na neku zasebnu žrtvu molitelja.

citations.document_title: Diary of Saint Maria Faustina Kowalska: Divine Mercy in My Soul

magisterium.assessment_en: The description of the Chaplet of Divine Mercy is substantially in accordance with Catholic faith: it directs prayer to the Father through Christ's passion and asks for mercy for all people. The phrase "in atonement" should be understood in dependence on Christ's unique sacrifice, and not as a repetition or supplementation of redemption by one's own power.
magisterium.enrichment_en: In the presented devotion, believers offer to the Father the body and blood, soul and divinity of Christ and unite themselves with His sacrifice while praying for themselves and the whole world. Christ offered His life on the cross as a sacrifice for sins; therefore, the invocation for mercy relies on His finished redemptive work, and not on some separate sacrifice of the person praying.

sections.subtitle_en: "For the sake of his sorrowful passion": Chaplet of the Divine Mercy
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host utters the prayer "Eternal Father, we offer you the body and blood…" at the beginning of a decade of the Chaplet of Mercy
sections.content_en:
"The Chaplet of the Divine Mercy follows," announces Vladimir Grebenar. That part forms the center of the prayer block and connects with the title of the episode, which is dedicated precisely to the Divine Mercy.

The Chaplet begins with the usual introductory prayers: **Our Father**, **Hail Mary**, and the **Creed**. In the Creed, faith is confessed in God the Father Almighty Creator, in Jesus Christ who "suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died and was buried" and rose on the third day, in the Holy Spirit, the holy Catholic Church, the communion of saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting.

Then follows the heart of this devotion. Each decade opens with an offering:

> "Eternal Father, we offer you the body and blood, soul and divinity of your dearly beloved Son, our Lord Jesus Christ, in atonement for our sins and those of the whole world."

After that, like a prayerful breath, the invocation follows several times in succession:

> "For the sake of his sorrowful passion, have mercy on us and on the whole world."

This pattern is repeated throughout all the decades, from roughly the fourth to the twelfth minute of the show. The uniform, meditative repetition places Christ's passion at the center of the prayer as the reason for which mercy is asked of the Father. At the same time, prayer is made not only for oneself, but for the "whole world."

sections.subtitle: „Isuse, uzdam se u tebe“: završni zazivi krunice milosrđa
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar moli „O krvi i vodo“ i trostruko „Isuse, uzdam se u tebe“
sections.content:
Krunica milosrđa završava trostrukim zazivom koji ima gotovo liturgijsku svečanost:

> „Sveti Bože, sveti jaki Bože, sveti besmrtni Bože, smiluj se nama i cijelome svijetu.“

Nakon toga Vladimir Grebenar moli zaziv usmjeren na izvor milosrđa:

> „O krvi i vodo, što potekoste iz srca Isusova kao izvor milosrđa za nas, uzdam se u tebe.“

Slijedi kratka molitva Mariji kao **majci milosrđa**. Zatim se tri puta ponavlja jednostavna rečenica koja sažima čitavu pobožnost: **„Isuse, uzdam se u tebe.“** Ponavljanje te rečenice pokazuje da se pobožnost Božjem milosrđu ne svodi na molbu za oproštenje. Ona je prije svega čin pouzdanja: molitelj se predaje Kristu, a ne samo nešto od njega traži.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je snažno usklađen s katoličkom pobožnošću Božjem milosrđu: pouzdanje u Krista i zaziv Mariji kao Majci milosrđa izražavaju vjeru u Božju milost i Marijino majčinsko posredovanje, a ne njezinu neovisnost o Kristu. Naglasak da se pobožnost ne svodi samo na molbu za oproštenje dobro je postavljen, pod uvjetom da pouzdanje uključuje obraćenje i ne zamjenjuje sakramentalni život.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveni nauk povezuje Marijin naslov Majke milosrđa s njezinim jedinstvenim sudjelovanjem u Kristovu djelu i trajnom majčinskom brigom za vjernike; Krist ostaje izvor spasenja i lice Božjeg milosrđa. Izraz „Isuse, uzdam se u tebe“ sažima kršćansko pouzdanje u Božju ljubav, ali nije obećanje da će čovjek biti pošteđen obraćenja ili odgovornosti za vlastiti život.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is strongly in alignment with Catholic devotion to the Divine Mercy: trust in Christ and the invocation of Mary as Mother of Mercy express faith in God's grace and Mary's maternal mediation, not her independence from Christ. The emphasis that devotion is not reduced merely to asking for forgiveness is well stated, provided that trust includes conversion and does not replace sacramental life.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Church teaching links Mary's title of Mother of Mercy with her unique participation in Christ's work and ongoing maternal care for believers; Christ remains the source of salvation and the face of the Father's mercy. The phrase "Jesus, I trust in You" summarizes Christian trust in God's love, but it is not a promise that one will be spared conversion or responsibility for one's own life.

sections.subtitle_en: "Jesus, I trust in you": concluding invocations of the Chaplet of Mercy
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar prays "O Blood and Water" and the threefold "Jesus, I trust in you"
sections.content_en:
The Chaplet of Mercy ends with a threefold invocation that possesses almost liturgical solemnity:

> "Holy God, Holy Mighty One, Holy Immortal One, have mercy on us and on the whole world."

After that, Vladimir Grebenar prays an invocation directed to the source of mercy:

> "O Blood and Water, which gushed forth from the Heart of Jesus as a fountain of mercy for us, I trust in you."

A short prayer to Mary as the **mother of mercy** follows. Then, a simple sentence that summarizes the entire devotion is repeated three times: **"Jesus, I trust in you."** The repetition of that sentence shows that devotion to the Divine Mercy is not reduced to a plea for forgiveness. It is above all an act of trust: the person praying surrenders to Christ, rather than merely asking for something from him.

sections.subtitle: Od stvaranja do čistilišta: litanije Božjem milosrđu
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli litanije Božjem milosrđu, ponavljajući zaziv „uzdam se u tebe“
sections.content:
Na krunicu milosrđa izravno se nadovezuju **litanije Božjem milosrđu**. Počinju klasičnim litanijskim uvodom („Gospodine, smiluj se. Kriste, smiluj se…“) i zazivima Oca, Sina, Duha Svetoga i Presvetoga Trojstva.

Zatim slijedi dugi niz zaziva, a svaki završava odgovorom **„uzdam se u tebe“**. Zajedno oni ocrtavaju cijelu povijest spasenja kao povijest Božjeg milosrđa. Milosrđe Božje u litanijama je, među ostalim:

- „neshvatljiva tajna Presvetoga Trojstva“ i „izraz njegove najveće moći“,
- ono koje se objavilo u stvaranju nebeskih duhova i koje je ljude „iz ništavila pozvalo u život“,
- ono koje obuhvaća čitav svijet i daruje besmrtan život,
- ono koje štiti od zasluženih kazni i oslobađa od „bijede grijeha“,
- ono koje se izlijeva iz rana Kristovih i izvire iz Presvetoga Srca,
- ono koje je ljudima dalo Presvetu Djevicu za majku milosrđa,
- vidljivo u ustanovljenju Crkve i u dijeljenju svetih sakramenata,
- „neograničeno u sakramentu krštenja i pokore“ te „neizmjerno u sakramentu oltara i svećeništva“,
- prisutno u obraćenju grešnika, posvećenju pravednika i usavršavanju svetih,
- „vrelo bolesnicima i patnicima“, utjeha skršenih srca i „ufanje onih koji očajavaju“,
- „mir umirućih“, ono koje čuva od paklenoga ognja i olakšava patnje dušama u čistilištu,
- „slast i neizmjerna radost sviju svetih“ te „neiscrpivi izvor čudesa“.

Litanije tako vode od samog stvaranja, preko sakramentalnog života Crkve i ljudskih patnji, sve do onostranosti: smrti, čistilišta i radosti svetih.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak uglavnom vjerno prikazuje Božje milosrđe kao djelovanje Presvetoga Trojstva kroz stvaranje, Kristovo otkupiteljsko djelo i život Crkve, uključujući sakramente i poziv na obraćenje. Litanijske tvrdnje o zaštiti od kazne, paklu i pomoći dušama u čistilištu valja razumjeti kao molitvene zazive i izraze pouzdanja, a ne kao jamstvo da sama molitva automatski uklanja posljedice grijeha ili zamjenjuje obraćenje.
concerns: Izrazi o zaštiti od zasluženih kazni i čuvanju od paklenoga ognja mogu biti nejasni ako se shvate kao bezuvjetno jamstvo neovisno o slobodnom odgovoru čovjeka, pokajanju i ustrajnosti u vjeri.
Dostavljeni kontekst podupire opće tvrdnje o milosrđu, sakramentalnom životu i zajedništvu svetih, ali ne daje izravan dokaz za konkretnu formulaciju o olakšavanju patnji duša u čistilištu.
magisterium.enrichment: Milosrđe ne ukida Božju pravednost: ono nudi oproštenje i preobražava grešnika, dok oprošteni grijesi mogu ostaviti posljedice koje traže daljnje ozdravljenje i rast u ljubavi. Crkva je sredstvo pomirenja, a Euharistija i sakrament pomirenja usmjeravaju vjernika prema Kristu; zato su litanije najplodnije kad pouzdanje u milosrđe prati obraćenje i život sakramenata.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage generally faithfully presents Divine Mercy as the action of the Most Holy Trinity through creation, Christ's redemptive work, and the life of the Church, including the sacraments and the call to conversion. The litany claims about protection from punishment, hell, and assistance to the souls in purgatory should be understood as prayerful invocations and expressions of trust, rather than as a guarantee that prayer itself automatically removes the consequences of sin or replaces conversion.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Mercy does not abolish God's justice: it offers forgiveness and transforms the sinner, while forgiven sins can leave consequences that require further healing and growth in love. The Church is the instrument of reconciliation, and the Eucharist and the sacrament of reconciliation direct the believer toward Christ; therefore, litanies are most fruitful when trust in mercy is accompanied by conversion and sacramental life.
concerns_en: Expressions regarding protection from deserved punishments and preservation from the fires of hell can be ambiguous if understood as an unconditional guarantee independent of human free response, repentance, and perseverance in faith.

The provided context supports general statements about mercy, sacramental life, and the communion of saints, but does not provide direct evidence for the concrete formulation regarding easing the sufferings of souls in purgatory.

sections.subtitle_en: From creation to purgatory: Litany of the Divine Mercy
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host prays the Litany of the Divine Mercy, repeating the invocation "I trust in you"
sections.content_en:
The **Litany of the Divine Mercy** follows directly upon the Chaplet of Mercy. It begins with the classic litany introduction ("Lord, have mercy. Christ, have mercy…") and invocations of the Father, Son, Holy Spirit, and the Most Holy Trinity.

Then follows a long series of invocations, and each ends with the response **"I trust in you"**. Together they outline the entire history of salvation as a history of God's mercy. In the litany, the Divine Mercy is, among other things:

- "unfathomable mystery of the Most Holy Trinity" and "expression of its greatest power",
- that which was revealed in the creation of heavenly spirits and which "called humans from nothingness into life",
- that which encompasses the entire world and bestows immortal life,
- that which protects from deserved punishments and delivers from the "misery of sin",
- that which pours forth from the wounds of Christ and springs from the Sacred Heart,
- that which gave the Blessed Virgin to humans as the mother of mercy,
- visible in the establishment of the Church and in the administration of the holy sacraments,
- "unlimited in the sacrament of baptism and penance" and "immeasurable in the sacrament of the altar and the priesthood",
- present in the conversion of sinners, the sanctification of the righteous, and the perfection of the saints,
- "fountain for the sick and suffering", consolation of crushed hearts, and "hope of those who despair",
- "peace of the dying", that which preserves from the fires of hell and alleviates the sufferings of the souls in purgatory,
- "sweetness and immense joy of all the saints" and "inexhaustible source of miracles".

The litany thus leads from creation itself, through the sacramental life of the Church and human sufferings, all the way to the afterlife: death, purgatory, and the joy of the saints.

sections.subtitle: Da ne očajavamo u teškim trenucima: molitva pouzdanja u Božju volju
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar moli završnu molitvu litanija o predanju u Božju volju
sections.content:
Litanije se zatvaraju psalamskim retkom: „Bog je milosrdan i pun samilosti, spor na srđbu i pun dobrote. Zato ću dovijeka klicati milosrđu Božjemu.“

Završna molitva obraća se vječnom Bogu, „čije je milosrđe neistraživo i čije je blago smilovanja neiscrpivo“. U njoj je sadržana jedna od najvažnijih poruka ovoga dijela emisije, molba da Bog umnoži svoje milosrđe u vjernicima:

> „…da u teškim trenucima ne očajavamo i ne budemo obeshrabreni, nego da se predamo s velikim pouzdanjem u tvoju svetu volju, koja je sama ljubav i smilovanje.“

Molitva završava Kristom, „kraljem milosrđa“, koji s Ocem i Duhom Svetim iskazuje milosrđe „u sve vijeke vjekova“. Time se zaokružuje cijeli blok posvećen Božjem milosrđu: pouzdanje i predanje Božjoj volji ističu se kao odgovor na očaj i obeshrabrenost.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je usklađen s katoličkim naukom: pouzdanje u Božje milosrđe i predanje Božjoj volji odgovaraju kršćanskoj nadi te Isusovoj molitvi: „Ne moja volja, nego tvoja neka bude.” Molitva ne promiče očaj, nego pouzdano obraćanje Bogu u teškoćama, što je u skladu s katoličkim naglaskom na povjerenju u Kristovo milosrđe.
magisterium.enrichment: Predanje Božjoj volji ne znači poricati bol, nepravdu ili potrebu da se traži pomoć; Isusova molitva u Getsemaniju pokazuje da se tjeskoba može iskreno izreći, a ipak povjeriti Ocu. Izraz da je Božja volja „sama ljubav i smilovanje” dobro izražava povjerenje u Boga, ali ne treba ga tumačiti kao tvrdnju da je svako zlo ili patnja nešto što Bog želi kao zlo.
magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is in alignment with Catholic doctrine: trust in God's mercy and surrender to God's will correspond to Christian hope and Jesus' prayer: "Not my will, but yours be done." The prayer does not promote despair, but a trusting turning to God in difficulties, which is in accordance with the Catholic emphasis on trust in Christ's mercy.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Surrender to God's will does not mean denying pain, injustice, or the need to seek help; Jesus' prayer in Gethsemane shows that anguish can be sincerely expressed and yet entrusted to the Father. The expression that God's will is "love and mercy itself" well expresses trust in God, but it should not be interpreted as a claim that every evil or suffering is something God wills as evil.

sections.subtitle_en: That we may not despair in difficult moments: prayer of trust in God's will
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar prays the concluding prayer of the litany on surrender to God's will
sections.content_en:
The litany closes with a psalm verse: "God is merciful and full of compassion, slow to anger and full of goodness. Therefore I will forever proclaim the mercy of God."

The concluding prayer addresses the eternal God, "whose mercy is unfathomable and whose treasure of compassion is inexhaustible." Contained within it is one of the most important messages of this part of the show, a plea for God to increase his mercy in the faithful:

> "…that in difficult moments we may not despair and not be discouraged, but may surrender ourselves with great trust into your holy will, which is love and compassion itself."

The prayer ends with Christ, the "king of mercy", who with the Father and the Holy Spirit shows mercy "forever and ever." With this, the entire block dedicated to the Divine Mercy is rounded off: trust and surrender to God's will are highlighted as an answer to despair and discouragement.

sections.subtitle: Krvavi znoj i bičevanje: početak žalosnih otajstava
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj najavljuje Gospinu krunicu i prvo žalosno otajstvo o krvavom znoju
sections.content:
„Slijedi Gospina krunica“, najavljuje Vladimir Grebenar. Te večeri mole se **žalosna otajstva**, koja prate Kristovu muku od Maslinske gore do križa. Time se Gospina krunica sadržajno nadovezuje na krunicu milosrđa, u čijem je središtu također bila „pregorka muka“.

Svako otajstvo ima istu strukturu:

- najava otajstva,
- **Oče naš**,
- niz molitava **Zdravo Marijo**,
- **Slava Ocu**,
- molitva „O moj Isuse, oprosti nam naše grijehe, očuvaj nas od paklenoga ognja, dovedi u raj sve duše, a osobito one kojima je najpotrebnije tvoje milosrđe“.

### Prvo otajstvo: „koji se za nas krvavim znojem znojio“

Prvo otajstvo podsjeća na Isusovu smrtnu tjeskobu, kada se prema predaji znojio krvavim znojem. Molitva teče mirno i ujednačeno, a ponavljanje anđeoskog pozdrava i zaziva „moli za nas grešnike sada i na času smrti naše“ daje joj kontemplativan ritam.

### Drugo otajstvo: „koji je za nas bio bičevan“

U drugom otajstvu, najavljenom oko 21. minute, molitelji razmatraju Kristovo bičevanje. Završna molitva „O moj Isuse“ i ovdje ponovno ističe temu milosrđa. Prvenstveno se moli za one duše „kojima je najpotrebnije tvoje milosrđe“, čime se Gospina krunica povezuje s ranijim dijelom emisije.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak vjerno prikazuje žalosna otajstva kao razmatranje Kristove muke te navodi pobožnu strukturu krunice i uobičajeni zaziv „O moj Isuse”. Crkveno je učenje da krunica odabire događaje Kristova života i muke kako bi ih vjernici razmatrali, a žalosna otajstva vode od Getsemanija prema Kristovoj smrti na križu.
magisterium.enrichment: Luka izvještava da je Isus u smrtnoj tjeskobi molio, a znoj mu je postao „kao kaplje krvi”; Ivan Pavao II. taj događaj povezuje sa stvarnošću Isusove ljudske naravi i njegovom poslušnošću Ocu. Zato prvo otajstvo ne govori samo o Isusovoj patnji nego i o njegovu slobodnom pristanku na Očevu volju. Molitva „O moj Isuse” u odlomku je predstavljena kao završni zaziv krunice, a njezina molba za milosrđe usklađena je s kršćanskim zagovorom za spasenje duša.

citations.document_title: Rosarium Virginis Mariae on the Most Holy Rosary

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage faithfully presents the sorrowful mysteries as a meditation on Christ's passion and cites the pious structure of the Rosary and the customary invocation "O my Jesus". Church teaching is that the Rosary selects events of Christ's life and passion for the faithful to meditate on, and the sorrowful mysteries lead from Gethsemane toward Christ's death on the cross.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Luke reports that Jesus prayed in mortal anguish, and His sweat became "like drops of blood"; John Paul II connects that event with the reality of Jesus' human nature and His obedience to the Father. Therefore, the first mystery speaks not only of Jesus' suffering but also of His free consent to the Father's will. The prayer "O my Jesus" is presented in the passage as the closing invocation of the Rosary, and its petition for mercy is aligned with Christian intercession for the salvation of souls.

sections.subtitle_en: Bloody sweat and scourging: the beginning of the sorrowful mysteries
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host announces the Rosary of Our Lady and the first sorrowful mystery of the bloody sweat
sections.content_en:
"The Rosary of Our Lady follows," announces Vladimir Grebenar. That evening, the **sorrowful mysteries** are prayed, which follow Christ's passion from the Mount of Olives to the cross. With this, the Rosary of Our Lady connects in content to the Chaplet of Mercy, at the center of which was also the "sorrowful passion."

Each mystery has the same structure:

- announcement of the mystery,
- **Our Father**,
- a series of **Hail Mary** prayers,
- **Glory Be to the Father**,
- the prayer "O my Jesus, forgive us our sins, save us from the fires of hell, lead all souls to heaven, especially those most in need of your mercy."

### First mystery: "who for us sweat bloody sweat"

The first mystery recalls Jesus' agony, when according to tradition he sweat bloody sweat. The prayer flows calmly and steadily, and the repetition of the angelic salutation and the invocation "pray for us sinners now and at the hour of our death" gives it a contemplative rhythm.

### Second mystery: "who for us was scourged"

In the second mystery, announced around the 21st minute, the persons praying contemplate Christ's scourging. The concluding prayer "O my Jesus" here again emphasizes the theme of mercy. Primarily, prayer is made for those souls "most in need of your mercy," whereby the Rosary of Our Lady is connected to the earlier part of the show.

sections.subtitle: Kruna od trnja, teški križ i raspeće
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar najavljuje peto žalosno otajstvo: „koji je za nas bio razapet“
sections.content:
U drugoj polovici krunice Vladimir Grebenar vodi molitelje kroz posljednje postaje Kristove muke.

### Treće otajstvo: „koji je za nas trnjem bio okrunjen“

Oko 25. minute najavljuje se krunjenje trnjem, poruga kojom je Krist kao „kralj“ ismijan i ponižen. Molitva slijedi isti obrazac: Oče naš, niz molitava Zdravo Marijo, Slava Ocu i molitva za oproštenje grijeha i spasenje duša.

### Četvrto otajstvo: „koji je za nas teški križ nosio“

Četvrto otajstvo, najavljeno oko 29. minute, posvećeno je putu na Kalvariju. Izraz „teški križ“ naglašava težinu tereta koji Krist nosi „za nas“, a ta se formulacija provlači kroz sva otajstva.

### Peto otajstvo: „koji je za nas bio razapet“

Vrhunac žalosnih otajstava dolazi oko 33. minute s razmatranjem raspeća. Nakon posljednjeg niza molitava Zdravo Marijo, Slava Ocu i molitve „O moj Isuse“ krunica se privodi kraju.

Kroz svih pet otajstava stalno se ponavlja formula **„za nas“**: znojio se za nas, bičevan za nas, okrunjen za nas, nosio križ za nas, razapet za nas. Ona Kristovu muku ne predstavlja kao daleki povijesni događaj, nego kao osobni dar svakome tko moli.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je u skladu s katoličkim naukom: krunjenje trnjem, nošenje križa i raspeće prikazuje kao stvarne trenutke Kristove muke te naglašava da je Krist trpio i predao se za naše spasenje. Ponavljanje izraza „za nas” ispravno ističe osobnu važnost Kristove žrtve, a ne umanjuje njezinu povijesnu stvarnost.
magisterium.enrichment: Kršćansko razmatranje muke ne zaustavlja se na Kristovoj patnji: ono vodi zahvalnosti i nasljedovanju njegove ljubavi, koja se daruje za dobro drugih. Tako papa Pavao VI. povezuje Kristovo predanje za nas s pozivom da se i vjernici daju za dobro bližnjih, dok liturgijsko tumačenje križa pokazuje kako Kristova smrt postaje izvor oproštenja i života.

sections.subtitle_en: Crown of thorns, heavy cross, and crucifixion
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar announces the fifth sorrowful mystery: "who for us was crucified"
sections.content_en:
In the second half of the Rosary, Vladimir Grebenar leads the persons praying through the last stations of Christ's passion.

### Third mystery: "who for us was crowned with thorns"

Around the 25th minute, the crowning with thorns is announced, the mockery by which Christ was ridiculed and humiliated as "king." The prayer follows the same pattern: Our Father, a series of Hail Mary prayers, Glory Be to the Father, and a prayer for the forgiveness of sins and the salvation of souls.

### Fourth mystery: "who for us carried the heavy cross"

The fourth mystery, announced around the 29th minute, is dedicated to the road to Calvary. The expression "heavy cross" emphasizes the weight of the burden that Christ carries "for us," and that formulation runs through all the mysteries.

### Fifth mystery: "who for us was crucified"

The culmination of the sorrowful mysteries arrives around the 33rd minute with the contemplation of the crucifixion. After the last series of Hail Mary prayers, Glory Be to the Father, and the prayer "O my Jesus," the Rosary is brought to an end.

Throughout all five mysteries, the formula **"for us"** is constantly repeated: he sweat for us, scourged for us, crowned for us, carried the cross for us, crucified for us. It presents Christ's passion not as a distant historical event, but as a personal gift to everyone who prays.

sections.subtitle: „Zdravo, Kraljice, majko milosrđa“: zaključak molitvenog dijela
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj moli „Zdravo Kraljice“ kao završetak Gospine krunice
sections.content:
Gospina krunica, a s njom i cijeli molitveni dio emisije, završava drevnom marijanskom antifonom **„Zdravo, Kraljice“**. Vladimir Grebenar pozdravlja Mariju kao „majku milosrđa, život, slast i ufanje naše“. Time se zatvara krug koji je otvoren litanijama i krunicom Božjega milosrđa, u kojima je Marija već bila zazvana kao majka milosrđa.

U molitvi se ljudi opisuju kao „prognani sinovi Jevini“ koji uzdišu „tugujući i plačući u ovoj suznoj dolini“. Od Marije, „zagovornice naše“, traži se da svrne svoje „milostive oči“ na molitelje te da im „poslije ovoga progona“ pokaže Isusa, „blagoslovljeni plod utrobe svoje“.

Zaključni zaziv **„O blaga, o mila, o slatka Djevice Marijo“** i tihi „Amen“ označavaju kraj više od pola sata molitve. Nakon toga emisija prelazi na tumačenje Svete riječi.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak vjerno prenosi sadržaj i katolički smisao antifone „Zdravo, Kraljice”: Marija se zaziva kao majka milosrđa i zagovornica, a molitva završava usmjerenjem prema Isusu, plodu njezine utrobe. Nema naznake da se Mariji pripisuje božanska vlast ili da se njezin zagovor postavlja umjesto Krista.
magisterium.enrichment: Naziv „Majka milosrđa” ima kristološko značenje: Marija je majka raspetoga i uskrsloga Krista te svojim zagovorom upućuje vjernike na njegovo milosrdno lice. Slika „prognanih sinova Jevinih” i „suzne doline” izražava ljudsko stanje udaljenosti, žalosti i čežnje za puninom spasenja; završna molba traži da Marija pokaže Isusa, a ne da zauzme njegovo mjesto.

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage faithfully conveys the content and Catholic meaning of the antiphon "Hail, Holy Queen": Mary is invoked as mother of mercy and advocate, and the prayer concludes with a direction toward Jesus, the fruit of her womb. There is no indication that divine power is attributed to Mary or that her intercession is placed instead of Christ.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The title "Mother of Mercy" has a christological meaning: Mary is the mother of the crucified and risen Christ and through her intercession points believers to His merciful face. The imagery of the "banished children of Eve" and the "valley of tears" expresses the human condition of distance, sorrow, and longing for the fullness of salvation; the final petition asks Mary to show Jesus, not to take His place.

sections.subtitle_en: "Hail, Holy Queen, mother of mercy": conclusion of the prayer part
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host prays "Hail, Holy Queen" as the conclusion of the Rosary of Our Lady
sections.content_en:
The Rosary of Our Lady, and with it the entire prayer part of the show, concludes with the ancient Marian antiphon **"Hail, Holy Queen"**. Vladimir Grebenar greets Mary as "mother of mercy, our life, our sweetness, and our hope." With this closes the circle opened by the litany and Chaplet of the Divine Mercy, in which Mary was already invoked as mother of mercy.

In the prayer, people are described as "poor banished children of Eve" who sigh, "mourning and weeping in this valley of tears." Mary, "our advocate," is asked to turn her "merciful eyes" toward the persons praying and, "after this exile," show them Jesus, "the blessed fruit of thy womb."

The concluding invocation **"O clement, O loving, O sweet Virgin Mary"** and a quiet "Amen" mark the end of more than half an hour of prayer. After that, the show moves on to the interpretation of the Holy Word.

sections.subtitle: Krist koji je „sam sebe oplijenio“: Poslanica Filipljanima kao polazište
sections.screenshot_description: Vladimir Grebenar najavljuje tumačenje svete riječi i čita iz Poslanice Filipljanima
sections.content:
Nakon završene Gospine krunice i molitve *Zdravo, Kraljice*, voditelj **Vladimir Grebenar** najavljuje središnji dio emisije, tumačenje svete riječi. Polazište je odlomak iz **Poslanice Filipljanima**, jedan od najpoznatijih kristoloških tekstova Novoga zavjeta.

Grebenar čita kako je Krist, „trajni lik Božji“, odbio držati se svoje jednakosti s Bogom „kao plijena“. Umjesto toga **„sam sebe oplijeni, uzevši lik sluge“**, postavši ljudima sličan. Ponizio se i bio poslušan **„do smrti, smrti na križu“**.

Upravo zbog tog poniženja, nastavlja odlomak, Bog ga je preuzvisio i darovao mu „ime nad svakim imenom“, kako bi se na ime Isusovo prignulo svako koljeno „nebesnika, zemnika i podzemnika“. Odlomak završava rečenicom koja je ujedno i naslov epizode: **„Isus Krist jest Gospodin na slavu Boga Oca.“**

Ta rečenica postaje glavna nit cijelog tumačenja. Voditelj ističe da ovo čitanje „dolazi u pravi trenutak“ i odmah ga povezuje s prilikama u današnjem svijetu.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak vjerno prenosi Fil 2,6–11: Krist se ponizio utjelovljenjem i poslušnošću sve do smrti na križu, a Otac ga je uzvisio, tako da se ispovijeda njegovo gospodstvo na slavu Očevu. Izraz „sam sebe oplijeni“ ne znači da se Krist odrekao božanstva, nego da je, ostajući Bog, uzeo ljudsku narav i lik sluge.
magisterium.enrichment: Himan iz Poslanice Filipljanima prikazuje Kristovo kretanje od božanske slave, preko stvarnog ljudskog života i smrti, do uzvišenja i javnog priznanja njegova gospodstva. „Ispraznjenje“ zato treba razumjeti kao ponizno prihvaćanje ljudskosti i služenja, a ne kao gubitak božanske naravi ili božanskih svojstava.

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage faithfully conveys Phil 2:6–11: Christ humbled Himself through incarnation and obedience even unto death on a cross, and the Father exalted Him, so that His lordship is confessed to the glory of the Father. The expression "emptied Himself" does not mean that Christ renounced His divinity, but that, remaining God, He took on human nature and the form of a servant.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The hymn from the Epistle to the Philippians shows Christ's movement from divine glory, through real human life and death, to exaltation and public acknowledgment of His lordship. The "emptying" should therefore be understood as a humble acceptance of humanity and servanthood, not as a loss of the divine nature or divine attributes.

sections.subtitle_en: Christ who "emptied himself": Epistle to the Philippians as a starting point
sections.screenshot_description_en: Vladimir Grebenar announces the interpretation of the holy word and reads from the Epistle to the Philippians
sections.content_en:
After concluding the Rosary of Our Lady and the prayer *Hail, Holy Queen*, the host **Vladimir Grebenar** announces the central part of the show, the interpretation of the holy word. The starting point is a passage from the **Epistle to the Philippians**, one of the most famous Christological texts of the New Testament.

Grebenar reads how Christ, "the enduring form of God," refused to cling to his equality with God "as a prey." Instead **"he emptied himself, taking the form of a servant"**, becoming like human beings. He humbled himself and was obedient **"unto death, death on a cross"**.

Precisely because of this humiliation, the passage continues, God highly exalted him and bestowed on him "the name above every name," so that at the name of Jesus every knee should bend "of those in heaven, on earth, and under the earth." The passage ends with the sentence that is also the title of the episode: **"Jesus Christ is Lord to the glory of God the Father."**

That sentence becomes the main thread of the entire interpretation. The host emphasizes that this reading "comes at the right moment" and immediately connects it with the circumstances in today's world.

sections.subtitle: Upozorenje na hereze: „Sve religije u jednu priču“ i New Age
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj upozorava na hereze i ideju stapanja svih religija u jednu
sections.content:
Grebenar tvrdi da svijetom danas „vladaju hereze“. Prema njegovim riječima, **„anticrkva“ i masoni** pokušavaju prevariti kršćane, Crkvu pa i crkvenu hijerarhiju. Sredstvo te prijevare, kaže, jest teza da su **sve religije od Boga** i da u njima ima toliko zajedničkog i dobrog da ih treba „sve zajedno upakirati u jednu priču“.

To naziva izričito **masonskim učenjem**. Masoni, tvrdi voditelj, vjeruju da sve religije treba stopiti u jednu, a ta nova religija već postoji i zove se **New Age**.

New Age opisuje kao „miks svega“, mješavinu koja uključuje:

- kršćanstvo,
- islam,
- hinduizam,
- budizam,
- razna poganska vjerovanja.

Tu mješavinu Grebenar naziva **„suvremenom religijom sotone“**. Pita se i zašto je Zli svojoj religiji dao baš ime „Novo doba“. Odgovor nalazi u uvjerenju da se i sotona priprema za nadolazeće razdoblje: čovječanstvo je, prema voditelju, na kraju jednog biblijskog doba koje traje oko 2000 godina, a uskoro nastupa novo.

magisterium.assessment: Upozorenje da sinkretizam i relativiziranje kršćanske objave nisu spojivi s katoličkom vjerom ima uporište u crkvenom nauku, a Crkva je naučavala da su načela slobodnog zidarstva nespojiva s kršćanskom vjerom. Međutim, tvrdnja da masoni kao takvi zagovaraju stapanje svih religija u New Age, kao i nazivanje New Agea „religijom sotone“ te vremenska tvrdnja o kraju dvotisućljetnog biblijskog doba, nisu potkrijepljene navedenim crkvenim izvorima; izrečene su kao zaključci bez dostatnog obrazloženja.
concerns: Službeni crkveni tekst potvrđuje nespojivost načela slobodnog zidarstva s kršćanskom vjerom, ali sam po sebi ne potvrđuje da masoni ujednačeno ispovijedaju konkretan program spajanja svih religija u New Age.

Kritika sinkretističkih elemenata New Agea ne opravdava bez dodatnog dokaza pripisivanje svakom njegovu obliku ili pripadniku jedinstvene namjere ni formulaciju da je riječ o „religiji sotone“. Crkveni izvor opisuje pokret kao raznolik i dvosmislen te kritizira određene nespojive ideje.
Podatak da se približava kraj biblijskog doba od oko 2000 godina nije potkrijepljen dostavljenim izvorima i u odlomku nije obrazložen.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolička kritika New Agea odnosi se osobito na sinkretizam, relativiziranje objave, panteističko shvaćanje Boga i zamjenu otkupljenja po Kristu neodređenom duhovnošću; to ne zahtijeva neutemeljene tvrdnje o skrivenoj koordiniranoj zavjeri. Kršćanska vjera ispovijeda jednoga Boga i Isusa Krista kao Gospodina, ali iz toga ne slijedi da je svaka pojedina tvrdnja ili praksa u drugim religijama jednaka kršćanskoj objavi, niti da se sve religije mogu stopiti u jednu.

magisterium.assessment_en: The warning that syncretism and relativizing Christian revelation are incompatible with the Catholic faith is grounded in Church teaching, and the Church has taught that the principles of Freemasonry are incompatible with the Christian faith. However, the claim that Freemasons as such advocate merging all religions into the New Age, as well as calling the New Age a "religion of satan" and the temporal claim about the end of a two-thousand-year biblical era, are not substantiated by the cited ecclesial sources; they are stated as conclusions without sufficient explanation.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic criticism of the New Age relates especially to syncretism, the relativization of revelation, a pantheistic understanding of God, and replacing redemption through Christ with vague spirituality; this does not require unsubstantiated claims about a hidden coordinated conspiracy. The Christian faith confesses one God and Jesus Christ as Lord, but it does not follow from this that every individual claim or practice in other religions equals Christian revelation, nor that all religions can be merged into one.
concerns_en: The official ecclesial text confirms the incompatibility of the principles of Freemasonry with the Christian faith, but does not in itself confirm that Masons uniformly profess a concrete program of merging all religions into the New Age.

Criticism of syncretistic elements of the New Age does not justify attributing a single intention to every form or member of it, nor the formulation that it is a "religion of satan", without additional proof. The ecclesial source describes the movement as diverse and ambiguous, and criticizes certain incompatible ideas.
The statement that the end of a biblical era of about 2000 years is approaching is not substantiated by the provided sources and is not explained in the passage.

sections.subtitle_en: Warning about heresies: "All religions into one story" and the New Age
sections.screenshot_description_en: The host warns about heresies and the idea of merging all religions into one
sections.content_en:
Grebenar asserts that today "heresies rule" the world. According to his words, the **"anti-church" and freemasons** are trying to deceive Christians, the Church, and even the ecclesiastical hierarchy. The means of this deception, he says, is the thesis that **all religions are from God** and that there is so much in common and good in them that they should "all be packaged together into one story."

He explicitly calls this **freemasonic teaching**. Freemasons, the host claims, believe that all religions should be merged into one, and that new religion already exists and is called the **New Age**.

He describes the New Age as a "mix of everything," a mixture that includes:

- Christianity,
- Islam,
- Hinduism,
- Buddhism,
- various pagan beliefs.

Grebenar calls that mixture the **"contemporary religion of Satan"**. He also wonders why the Evil One gave his religion the exact name "New Age." He finds the answer in the conviction that Satan too is preparing for the upcoming period: humanity is, according to the host, at the end of a biblical era that lasts about 2,000 years, and a new one is beginning soon.

sections.subtitle: Novo biblijsko doba: Garabandal, Akita, Međugorje i „plava knjiga“
sections.screenshot_description: Grebenar govori o proroštvima iz Garabandala, Akite i Međugorja te o novom dobu
sections.content:
Govoreći o prijelazu u novo razdoblje, voditelj se poziva na Gospine riječi: **„Neće biti smak svijeta, ali će nastupiti novo doba.“** Navodi da je to sadržano u proroštvima iz **Garabandala** i **Akite** te da se spominje i u **Međugorju**, u vezi s **trijumfom Marijina Bezgrešnoga Srca**. Međugorje posebno naglašava i dodaje da se i sam trenutno nalazi ondje.

Prema Grebenarovu tumačenju, New Age je **pokušaj Zloga da zavlada novim dobom**: da sebi „produži vijek“ i u novo razdoblje uđe kao gospodar zemlje i čovječanstva. Kad bi uspio srušiti Crkvu, kaže voditelj, time bi za svu budućnost **obezvrijedio žrtvu Isusa Krista na križu** i spasenje više ne bi bilo moguće. Podsjeća da u Svetom pismu stoji kako će Zlome vlast biti dana na određeno vrijeme te da se, prema Knjizi Otkrivenja, nitko ne bi spasio kad se to vrijeme ne bi skratilo.

Zatim spominje takozvanu **„plavu knjigu“**, u kojoj Gospa don Stefanu Gobiju govori da slijedi **konačna bitka između dobra i zla**, a strana koja pobijedi vladat će zauvijek na zemlji.

Voditelj ne tvrdi kad će se to dogoditi. Veliki događaji, kaže, možda su već nastupili, a mogu nastupiti i za mjesec dana, za pet godina ili za sto godina. To ovisi o tome hoće li Bog Otac odgoditi kaznu ako vjernici izmole njegovo **milosrđe i oproštenje grijeha**. Pritom se poziva na Gospine riječi iz Akite i s drugih mjesta ukazanja, prema kojima je ona sa svojim Sinom zagovarala pred Ocem da svijet ne pogode kazne kao posljedice grijeha.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak sadrži kršćanski razumljive teme molitve, obraćenja i Božjega milosrđa, ali iznosi neprovjerene privatne objave i apokaliptične zaključke kao da daju pouzdan opis budućnosti. Posebno je problematično sugerirati da bi Zli mogao srušiti Crkvu i time obezvrijediti Kristovu žrtvu: takva formulacija zamagljuje dovršenost Kristove objave i jedinstveno značenje njegova spasenjskog djela.
concerns: Poruke pripisane Garabandalu, Akiti, Međugorju i don Stefanu Gobiju privatne su objave, a ne dio javne Objave; vjernici nisu obvezni prihvatiti ih kao nauk vjere, a valja ih prosuđivati u svjetlu Krista i crkvenog razlučivanja.

Tvrdnja o novom dobu i završnoj zemaljskoj bitci ne smije se predstavljati kao sigurno utvrđen biblijski raspored događaja. Ako izraz o pobjedničkoj strani koja će zauvijek vladati na zemlji znači zemaljsko kraljevstvo prije konačnog Kristova dolaska, potrebno ga je pojasniti kako ne bi sugerirao milenarističko tumačenje; dostupni izvori ne omogućuju zaključak o točnom sadržaju te navodne poruke.

Sugestija da bi pobjeda Zloga mogla obezvrijediti Kristovu žrtvu pretjeruje moć zla i može navesti na pomisao da Kristovo spasenjsko djelo ovisi o predviđenom tijeku apokaliptičnih događaja. Kršćanska objava dovršena je u Kristu; privatne objave ne mogu je nadmašiti ni ispraviti.

Pripisivanje tijeka događaja odgodi kazne koju Bog Otac može promijeniti po molitvama, kao i tvrdnje o kaznama vezane uz navodna ukazanja, zahtijevaju oprez: poruke koje predviđaju katastrofe mogu biti uvjetne, a za Međugorje vatikanska bilješka izričito upozorava na oprez pri tumačenju poruka i odbacuje katastrofična predviđanja određenog datuma.

Nazivanje New Agea pokušajem Zloga da zavlada novim dobom može biti autorovo duhovno tumačenje, ali u odlomku nije potkrijepljeno jasnim biblijskim argumentom ili crkvenim naukom te se ne bi smjelo predstavljati kao utvrđena činjenica.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkva razlikuje javnu Objavu, dovršenu u Isusu Kristu, od privatnih objava koje mogu pomoći vjernicima živjeti Evanđelje, ali ga ne dopunjuju i ne obvezuju na vjeru. Apokaliptične slike treba čitati uz svijest da Krist nije objavio kronološki datum svršetka i da potresi i previranja sami po sebi ne dokazuju njegovu blizinu. Najsigurniji naglasak odlomka stoga je poziv na obraćenje, milosrđe i vjernost Kristu, a ne nagađanje o novom dobu ili pojedinostima buduće kazne.

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage contains Christianly understandable themes of prayer, conversion, and Divine Mercy, but presents unverified private revelations and apocalyptic conclusions as if they provided a reliable description of the future. It is particularly problematic to suggest that the Evil One could bring down the Church and thereby invalidate Christ's sacrifice: such a formulation obscures the definitive completeness of Christ's revelation and the unique significance of His redemptive work.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Church distinguishes public Revelation, completed in Jesus Christ, from private revelations that may help the faithful live the Gospel, but do not complete it and do not bind to faith. Apocalyptic imagery should be read with the awareness that Christ did not reveal a chronological date of the end and that upheavals and turmoil do not in themselves prove its proximity. The safest emphasis of the passage is therefore the call to conversion, mercy, and fidelity to Christ, rather than speculation about a new era or details of future punishment.
concerns_en: The messages attributed to Garabandal, Akita, Međugorje, and Father Stefano Gobbi are private revelations, not part of public Revelation; the faithful are not obliged to accept them as doctrine of the faith, and they should be judged in the light of Christ and ecclesial discernment.

The claim of a new era and a final earthly battle must not be presented as a securely established biblical timeline of events. If the expression about the winning side ruling forever on earth means an earthly kingdom before the final coming of Christ, it needs to be clarified so as not to suggest a millenarian interpretation; available sources do not allow a conclusion regarding the exact content of that alleged message.

The suggestion that the victory of the Evil One could invalidate Christ's sacrifice exaggerates the power of evil and can suggest the thought that Christ's redemptive work depends on a predicted course of apocalyptic events. Christian revelation is completed in Christ; private revelations cannot surpass or correct it.

Attributing the course of events to a postponement of punishment that God the Father can change through prayers, as well as claims about punishments linked to alleged apparitions, require caution: messages predicting catastrophes may be conditional, and for Međugorje the Vatican note explicitly warns of caution when interpreting messages and rejects catastrophic predictions of a specific date.

Calling the New Age an attempt by the Evil One to take over the new era may be the author's spiritual interpretation, but it is not substantiated in the passage by a clear biblical argument or Church teaching, and should not be presented as an established fact.

sections.subtitle_en: New biblical era: Garabandal, Akita, Međugorje, and the "blue book"
sections.screenshot_description_en: Grebenar speaks about prophecies from Garabandal, Akita, and Međugorje and about the new era
sections.content_en:
Speaking about the transition into a new period, the host refers to Our Lady's words: **"There will be no end of the world, but a new era will begin."** He states that this is contained in the prophecies from **Garabandal** and **Akita**, and that it is also mentioned in **Međugorje**, in connection with the **triumph of Mary's Immaculate Heart**. He emphasizes Međugorje especially and adds that he himself is currently located there.

According to Grebenar's interpretation, the New Age is **the Evil One's attempt to rule over the new era**: to "extend his lifespan" and enter the new period as master of the earth and mankind. If he succeeded in tearing down the Church, says the host, with that he would for all future **devalue the sacrifice of Jesus Christ on the cross** and salvation would no longer be possible. He recalls that Scripture states that the Evil One will be given authority for a certain time, and that, according to the Book of Revelation, no one would be saved if that time were not shortened.

Then he mentions the so-called **"blue book"**, in which Our Lady tells Don Stefano Gobbi that the **final battle between good and evil** is to follow, and the side that wins will rule forever on earth.

The host does not claim when this will happen. Great events, he says, may have already begun, or they may occur in a month, in five years, or in a hundred years. That depends on whether God the Father will postpone the punishment if the faithful pray for his **mercy and the forgiveness of sins**. In doing so, he refers to Our Lady's words from Akita and from other places of apparition, according to which she, with her Son, interceded before the Father so that punishments as consequences of sin would not strike the world.
keywords_en: final battle of good and evil

sections.subtitle: Znakovi vremena i priprema kroz navještaj Krista
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj govori o duhovnim znakovima vremena i vremenu velikih previranja
sections.content:
Grebenar opisuje sadašnjicu kao **„vrijeme velikih previranja“** koje se „gleda svojim očima“ i „osjeti“. Usporedbom iz evanđelja objašnjava da postoje **duhovni znakovi vremena**, slični onima na nebu po kojima se zna kad će kiša ili kad će se razdaniti. Ono što se danas događa u svijetu, prema njegovu tumačenju, upućuje na to da završava jedno biblijsko doba, a Bog vjernike za to priprema.

Glavnu pripremu voditelj vidi u jednome: **u navještaju Isusa Krista, Sina Božjega**. „Ovo je tako bitno“, naglašava. Time se vraća na čitanje iz Poslanice Filipljanima i ponovno ističe da će se na ime Isusovo prignuti svako koljeno i da će svaki jezik priznati da je Isus Krist Gospodin na slavu Boga Oca.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je u svojoj središnjoj poruci uglavnom usklađen s katoličkom vjerom: navještaj Isusa Krista i ispovijest njegova gospodstva odgovaraju Poslanici Filipljanima. Ipak, tvrdnja da događaji današnjice pokazuju završetak jednog biblijskog doba nadilazi ono što se može sigurno zaključiti iz općih znakova vremena.
concerns: Opis sadašnjosti kao vremena koje najavljuje kraj jednoga biblijskog doba nije popraćen dokazom i može potaknuti pretjerano eshatološko tumačenje aktualnih događaja. Crkveni nauk upozorava da Krist nije objavio kronološki datum svršetka i da su previranja tek početak muka, a ne siguran dokaz da je kraj neposredan.
magisterium.enrichment: Citirana ispovijest da je Isus Krist Gospodin na slavu Boga Oca izravno odgovara Fil 2,10–11 i izražava središte kršćanske vjere. Kršćansko iščekivanje svršetka zato treba usmjeravati prema Kristu i vjernom življenju Evanđelja, a ne prema određivanju vremenskih rokova; previranja mogu pozivati na budnost, ali ne daju siguran kalendar posljednjih događaja.
